description:
Run Python with the selected runtime and Locus SDK. `locus`, `project`, and `workspace_ref` are injected into an async body; top-level await works. Pass workspace_ref to checkout-scoped runs and tool calls.

Use action=help for SDK topics. Discover with locus.list_agents(), list_sessions(), list_running_sessions(), and list_tools(); running sessions support send_message(). For action=run, readonly=true requires the body and every nested SDK/tool call to be observation-only. Task APIs are built in: await locus.list_tasks() lists only current-session tasks; get_task_status(id), wait_task(id, timeout=30), cancel_task(id), resume_task(id, message=...) and send_message(id, text) use short task ids or assigned subagent names. Resume supports failed/cancelled subagents only. Messages to finished subagents automatically continue their existing conversation; children can message parent. Task-control-only scripts use readonly=true to avoid waiting for the workspace mutation lock. No tool loading is needed. Use action=help topic=tasks for details.

action.description: Run Python code, or progressively load one SDK help topic. Default run.

code.description: Python statements executed inside an async function. `locus`, `project`, and `workspace_ref` are already defined; top-level await is supported. Required for action=run.

topic.description: SDK documentation topic returned by action=help. Default overview.

readonly.description: Whether the Python body and all nested SDK/tool calls only observe state. Required for action=run; help is always read-only.

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for sync execution. Default 120000; maximum 1800000. Background async/notify execution has no deadline.
